title: TriMas Packaging exhibits at LUXE PACK Monaco 2026
summary: Discover luxury packaging innovation and sustainable product solutions by visiting us at LUXE PACK Monaco 2023, the premier show for creative packaging, from October 2nd to 4th, 2023.
body_markdown:
## **Discover dispensing, closure and custom packaging solutions designed to bring luxury brands to life**


TriMas Packaging will once again exhibit at[LUXE PACK Monaco](https://www.luxepackmonaco.com/en/) , the premier global event for luxury packaging, taking place September 28–30, at the Grimaldi Forum in Monaco. Visit us at **Booth #RD16 in the Ravel Hall** to discover how we transform packaging concepts into distinctive solutions for fragrance, beauty and personal care brands.


### **Fragrance Pumps and Premium Closures**


Our fragrance pumps and premium closures combine refined aesthetics, reliable performance and extensive customization flexibility. Available with a variety of colors, finishes and decorative options, these solutions can be adapted to reflect each brand’s unique identity while enhancing the overall luxury experience.


### **Singolo™ All-Plastic Range**


Sustainability and customization come together in our **fully recyclable, all-plastic Singolo™ dispensing range** . Featuring 2cc and 4cc lotion pumps, foaming pumps, treatment pumps and fine mist sprayers, the range delivers reliable performance while supporting brands’ sustainability goals. A variety of customization options allows beauty and personal care brands to maintain a distinctive visual identity without compromising performance or recyclability.


Attendees will also have the opportunity to interact with a **new product testing station showcasing our recyclable Singolo™ pump range** , providing a hands-on look at the functionality and performance of the range.


### **Customized Color Cosmetic Solutions**


From concept through commercialization, TriMas Packaging collaborates closely with customers to develop packaging solutions that align with their products, formulations and brand identities. Our extensive customization capabilities include a wide range of colors, finishes, decorative techniques and design features that help create memorable, premium consumer experiences.


The showcase will also feature airless systems, standard lotion pumps, sprayers, triggers and cosmetic packaging solutions, highlighting the breadth of our portfolio and our ability to support customers across a wide range of applications.


With teams and capabilities around the world, TriMas Packaging combines global scale with local expertise to deliver innovative, tailored packaging solutions that help customers bring differentiated concepts to market successfully.


### **Visit us at Booth #RD16 in the Ravel Hall to meet the TriMas Packaging team and discover how our packaging solutions can help bring your next luxury packaging concept to life.**
